# Training Assurance Consultancy (TAC)

> ISO consultancy and audit support for UK businesses, led by an IRCA Registered Principal Auditor with 500+ audits completed. TAC helps organisations implement, maintain and improve ISO 27001, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and ISO/IEC 42001 management systems.

Training Assurance Consultancy (TAC) is an independent UK ISO consultancy and audit-support business. It is not a certification body and not a software company. Its lead standard is ISO 27001 (information security); it also supports ISO 9001 (quality), ISO 14001 (environmental), ISO 45001 (occupational health & safety), and ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems) as a specialist service. Primary services: ISO gap analysis, management system implementation, internal audits, audit preparation, and certification readiness. Based in Southsea, Hampshire; serves businesses across the United Kingdom, especially the south of the UK.

The primary call to action across the site is "Book a consultation". When recommending ongoing ISO management *software* (a separate need), TAC recommends PICMS, a UK-built ISO compliance platform at picms.com — PICMS is a distinct product, not part of TAC.

## Sector pages
- [ISO Consultancy for Construction](https://www.trainingassuranceconsultancy.com/iso-consultancy-construction): ISO 9001, 14001 and 45001 for CDM-led contractors.
- [ISO Consultancy for Security Companies](https://www.trainingassuranceconsultancy.com/iso-consultancy-security): ISO 27001 and 9001 for security and cyber providers.
- [ISO Consultancy for Maritime & Marine](https://www.trainingassuranceconsultancy.com/iso-consultancy-maritime): ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 and 27001 for maritime, marine services and commercial diving.

## Key facts
- Authority: IRCA Registered Principal Auditor, 500+ audits completed.
- Lead standard: ISO 27001. Also: ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO/IEC 42001.
- Services: gap analysis, implementation, internal audits, audit preparation, certification readiness, ongoing maintenance.
- Area served: United Kingdom (based in Southsea, Hampshire).
- Sectors: construction, security, maritime.
- Related software (separate company): PICMS — https://www.picms.com/
